dialogues.speaker: Behnam
dialogues.text: The Akademiya sent me here to take charge of overseeing and maintaining the fortification work at the desert's edge. I usually stay in the pitstop.

dialogues.speaker: Behnam
dialogues.text: The rainforest is of utmost importance to the lives of Sumeru's people. We can't allow the desert to erode it.

dialogues.speaker: Behnam
dialogues.text: Wall of Samiel is our key defense against the sandstorm. We must practice thorough and effective defense with it.
